request.style: English, male baritone solo with choir, acoustic guitar, upright bass, piano, brushed drums, mournful and steady, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
At the Ahava canal we stood
Twelve leaders set apart by hand
Silver and gold in our care
For the house of the living God
We carried the vessels of praise
To restore the broken altar

[Chorus]
Watch answering watch we stay
Praise and thanks in day and night
Following David the man of God
Keeping the covenant tight
Hashabiah leads the song
In the rhythm of the Lord

[Verse]
Beside Rehum we made repairs
Ruler of half the district
Building the wall stone by stone
In the service of His spirit
We sealed the covenant with God
Under Nehemiah's care
Our names are written in the dust
Bound to the holy air

[Chorus]
Watch answering watch we stay
Praise and thanks in day and night
Following David the man of God
Keeping the covenant tight
Hashabiah leads the song
In the rhythm of the Lord

[Bridge]
In the days of Joiakim
And the priest and scribe Ezra
We kept the gates and the store
With no pause in our labor
Serving in the work of God
From the morning to the eve

[Outro]
Watch answering watch we stay
In the house of the Lord
